children: Sweden life science group's Q2 net sales rose sharply yr/yr, driven by Syntagon acquisition
Operating profit for Q2 remained negative, impacted by acquisition-related income
Company appointed new CFO after period's end
Company aims to increase Syntagon sales, capacity utilization and profitability in H2 2026
Nanologica focuses on converting customer pipeline into commercial orders and scaling up sales
Company sees opportunities from pharmaceutical firms shifting production to Europe and US
SYNTAGON ACQUISITION - Q2 sales growth driven by Syntagon acquisition, which accounted for most net sales
SALES ORGANIZATION - Recruitment of new Sales Director at Syntagon aimed at increasing sales and improving profitability
CUSTOMER PIPELINE - Nanologica reported a growing pipeline of customers evaluating chromatography products, with focus on converting evaluations to commercial orders
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Nanologica AB (publ) is SEK1.70, about 246.9% above its August 28 closing price of SEK0.49
The stock recently traded at 25 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 16 three months ago
